column1: # MAP0 WAYPOINTS TAKEN FROM uo-offline. NOT SHARD DATA.
# WHY THESE AND NOT THE REST. uo-offline's file mixes two very different
# things. Its vendor, bank, inn and healer entries were EXPORTED FROM ITS OWN
# LIVE NPCs -- its header says so -- and vendor positions are a property of a
# shard's spawn scripts, not of the map. Importing those would point our bots
# at places our vendors are not. They are deliberately excluded.
# What IS here is map0 GEOMETRY, which is the same world on every shard:
# dungeon rooms, descends, ascends and entrances, docks, and moongates.
# STRUCTURAL CHECK PASSED, WALKABILITY NOT VERIFIED. 283 of the 293 dungeon
# points fall in map0's dungeon strip (x >= 5120) and the 10 that do not are
# overworld entrances, which is exactly the right shape; docks and moongates
# are all overworld. But NO check has been done that our own navgrid can stand
# on these tiles. Treat every row as a LEAD, the same way the atlas separates a
# hinted resource spot from an earned one -- a place worth trying, not a place
# Our own atlas already carries 15 dungeon ENTRANCES and no interior structure
# at all, which is the gap this fills: 'graduate to harder hunting' needs to
# know where the inside of a dungeon goes.
